terbaru.judul: Genetic Algorithm Based Coordination and Optimization Model for Generation Grid Load Storage in Active Distribution Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: Create an optimization framework that combines fuzzy logic and genetic algorithms for risk assessment and coordination of generation, grid connection, load, and energy storage facilities in active distribution networks.

terbaru.judul: Aidos: A Hybrid Optimization Algorithm for Beam Hopping Scheduling in NGSO Mega-Constellations
terbaru.pelajaran: To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel BH scheduling algorithm Aidos.

terbaru.judul: Design and optimization of an AZO-based plasmonic metasurface-driven optical solar reflector for thermal management
terbaru.pelajaran: Plasmonic metasurface-driven Optical Solar Reflectors (m-OSRs) offer a promising route towards lightweight and high-performance thermal management.

terbaru.judul: Genetic Algorithms with Optimization Guided Operators
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a general model of genetic algorithms and formulate optimization in this model as a query complexity problem, using the language of reinforcement learning.

terbaru.judul: Acoda: Adversarial Code Obfuscation for Defending against LLM-based Analysis
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this issue, we propose Acoda, a genetic algorithm-based adversarial code obfuscation framework that defends against LLM-based code analysis.

terbaru.judul: The Fuel Optimizer: A Data-Driven Numerical Framework for Formulation of Aviation Turbine Fuel
terbaru.pelajaran: The Fuel Optimizer is an inverse design framework for sustainable aviation fuels that starts from a user-defined merit function and identifies the optimal combination of chemical species or hydrocarbon families that optimize a combination of targets.

terbaru.judul: Model-based Optimization of Anguilliform Swimming Gaits for Soft Robotic Applications
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we introduce the Soft Lamprey-Inspired Dual Environment Robot (SLIDER) and a proper modeling and optimization procedure employed to design the robot.

terbaru.judul: Discovering Interpretable Multi-Parameter Control Policies for Evolutionary Algorithms Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We demonstrate how deep-RL can be leveraged to overcome this barrier, using the (1+($λ$,$λ$))-genetic algorithm optimizing OneMax, one of the few problems where a super-constant speedup of dynamic control has been formally proven, as a representative case study.

terbaru.judul: An Opticalmechanics Framework for Dynamic Estimation of Multibody Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this issue, this study proposes an opticalmechanics kinematic-dynamic integrated estimation framework for multibody systems.

terbaru.judul: Randomized Constructive Heuristics for the VRPTW: A Focus on Regret-k
terbaru.pelajaran: This work studies three classical constructive heuristics - Nearest Neighbor, Best Insertion, and Regret-k - within a randomized, multi-start framework, a setting that remains largely under-explored despite their well-established deterministic use.
